section: North Carolina property tax: state rules
label: Levied by
value: Counties and municipalities (plus special districts); collected locally
note: The bill uses the combined county and municipal/district rate per $100 of appraised value.
source_title: NCDOR: How To Calculate A Tax Bill

section: North Carolina property tax: state rules
label: State oversight

note: NCDOR does not send bills or collect property tax; counties do.

section: North Carolina real estate transfer tax
label: Excise tax on real estate conveyances
value: $1 per $500 (or fraction) of the consideration or value conveyed
note: State excise (revenue stamp) tax under G.S. Chapter 105, Article 8E. Source is an NCDOR statistical abstract table (FY 2014-15 edition).
source_title: NCDOR Statistical Abstract: Table 51, Excise [Stamp] Tax on Conveyances (PDF)

section: North Carolina real estate transfer tax
label: Who pays the excise tax
value: Transferor (seller), paid to the county register of deeds before recording
note: Half of the proceeds stay with the county; the rest goes to the state.
source_title: NCDOR Statistical Abstract: Table 51, Excise [Stamp] Tax on Conveyances (PDF)
